mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pf.space s WHERE s.id=#{actor.spaceId} AND s.type='PERSONAL' AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId}) AND (CAST(#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w WHERE w.id=#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND w.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND w.state='READY' FOR SHARE OF w)) ELSE false END
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r62:bindings:' || CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text) || ':' || CAST(#{actor.userId} AS text),0))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.capability_binding_set(id,space_id,owner_user_id,workspace_id,inherit_personal) VALUES(#{id},#{actor.spaceId},#{actor.userId},#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER}, CASE WHEN CAST(#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.capability_binding_set SET revision=revision+1,inherit_personal=#{inherit} WHERE id=#{setId} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pf.capability_binding_selection WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND binding_set_id=#{setId}
